headline: Tower Records Japan reported exposure of about 11 million personal records, not a count of distinct customers. Korea Electric Power Corporation confirmed exposure for 650,487 billing-platform users and notified 869,761 procurement users while it investigates the scope there.

incidents.what: Tower Records Japan said an intruder accessed its online store and exposed customer records, including login information and some membership and delivery details.
incidents.scale: About 11M records; unique customer count undisclosed

incidents.what: KEPCO confirmed exposure in its billing and procurement systems, but the number of procurement users whose data was exposed remains unknown.
incidents.scale: 650,487 billing users confirmed; 869,761 procurement users notified

incidents.what: Together AI confirmed that an unauthorized party downloaded stored samples of customer prompts after a repository credential was exposed.
Rackspace warned that an intruder logged in with leaked credentials and could access Kubernetes secrets in some customer clusters.
Cyber reported unexpected minting on Solana and a matching outflow from its bridge on Ethereum; Upbit and Bithumb suspended CYBER transfers.
Norway’s digitalisation agency said a denial-of-service attack disrupted its national ID-porten sign-in service.
Users reported possible exposure of requests sent through GMI Cloud; OpenRouter’s public update did not identify that provider.
Chainflip confirmed theft from two vaults and offered a recovery bounty; the combined dollar value is a media estimate, and no recovery was reported.
incidents.scale: About $12M estimated across Ethereum and Bitcoin

incidents.what: Autopay said it shared incident findings with banks and the financial regulator and plans to brief e-commerce firms.
Novita confirmed MiniMax requests were forwarded outside the intended scope; OpenRouter removed three providers but found no breach of its own systems.
GL.iNet staff clarified that a Comet 5G with no signs of infection does not need a factory reset after the cloud flaw was fixed.
